item.title: Decoding Alzheimer's: Using Algorithms to Predict Cognitive Decline
item.description:
🎙️ ISTAART Voices Podcast

I had the pleasure of joining Dr. Auriel Willette (Rutgers University) on the ISTAART Voices podcast to discuss our work on using algorithms to predict cognitive decline in Alzheimer’s disease.

In this episode, we explore:

  • How machine learning and predictive algorithms can identify early markers of cognitive decline
  • The intersection of data science and neurodegenerative disease research
  • Translating algorithmic predictions into clinically meaningful insights
  • Future directions for AI-driven approaches in Alzheimer’s research
